1.o: Ganta quickly learns of the very real dangers lurking around every corner in Deadman Wonderland. He soon meets the unusual Shiro, and while defending her from other inmates, discovers a strange new power within himself.

2.o: In order to earn “cast points” that he can use to buy antidote for the poison injected by his collar, Ganta goes head to head with one of the prison’s toughest inmates in a deadly obstacle course.

3.o: Unable to afford antidote, Ganta faces his impending death - until You comes to his rescue. Later, after learning that the Red Man might be an inmate, Ganta, Shiro, and You venture into the secluded G Block to find the truth.

4.o: Ganta is locked away in Tamaki’s lab after tangling with Senji, who wields powers similar to his own. While quarantined, Ganta learns more about his new abilities - and discovers that he’ll soon have to use them in a fight to the death.

5.o: When Ganta faces Senji in his first Carnival Corpse, he learns that the effect of using his powers recklessly might be even deadlier than his opponent. Meanwhile, Yoh discovers there is more to Shiro than meets the eye.

6.o: Ganta meets Minatsuki, who’s locked up for killing her abusive father. When Ganta’s efforts to help her escape are thwarted, he’s forced to take on Minatsuki in a Carnival Corpse - and the girl shows her cruel true colors.

7.o: Ganta meets Karako and Nagi, the leaders of the rebel faction Scar Chain, who help Minatsuki out of a potentially gruesome bind. Unfortunately, Ganta also meets Genkaku, a guitar-toting monk with a real talent for brutal violence.

8.o: Ganta decides to join Scar Chain after hearing their plan to expose Deadman Wonderland’s darkest secrets. The plot isn’t without risks - and there’s a chance that the Undertakers are already working to sabotage the operation.

9.o: Ganta and his Scar Chain comrades find themselves bloodied after an encounter with Genkaku’s crew. Things don’t get any better when the battle ends, thanks to a sudden appearance and shocking decision by Shiro.

10.o: Ganta lashes out at Shiro for destroying the data chip and the Scar Chain’s resolve continues to be tested thanks to a traitorous confession by Rokuro. Things are looking grim for Ganta and his allies - until Senji enters the fight.

11.o: Ganta asks Senji to train him to better utilize his powers in battle. Later, after Karako is captured trying to save Nagi, Ganta unleashes his new skills during a rescue attempt - but it might already be too late, thanks to Genkaku.

12.o: Ganta, battered in battle and weakened by the poison coursing through his body, tries to use the last of his strength to take out Genkaku - but Shiro might be his only hope.

1.o: Newly elected Pope Pius XIII, a.k.a. Lenny Belardo, defies Vatican expectations as he begins his reign.

2.o: Lenny sets down the ground rules for his first speech at St. Peter's. Cardinal Spencer spurns an olive branch.

3.o: After his inaugural speech makes it clear that he will not be manipulated, Lenny makes enemies within the Vatican. However, he gains one ardent follower.

4.o: Believing that the only way to end Lenny's papacy is to involve him in a scandal, Cardinal Secretary of State Voiello blackmails Ester to seduce the pontiff.

5.o: Lenny enjoys a night away from the Vatican with a childhood friend, whilst Voiello has a crisis of conscience when an opportunity presents itself.

6.o: Nine months into Lenny's papacy, he gives his first audience to the Italian prime minister. Dussolier carries out a controversial edict.

7.o: Dussollier blames himself after a tragedy and returns to Honduras. With Lenny's supporters dwindling, he questions whether his papacy is coming to an end.

8.o: Reeling from a personal loss, Pope Pius XIII makes an impulsive decision to visit Africa, meeting a revered missionary who stirs mixed feelings inside him.

9.o: Gutierrez is dejected by his failure to find evidence against Cardinal Kurtwell, but a new witness may be able to give him what he is looking for.

10.o: Pope Pius XIII prepares to reveal himself publicly for the first time in a pastoral visit to Venice, but not before settling some scores.

1.o: Ko Dong-man, Choi Ae-ra, Baek Sul-hee and Kim Joo-man weren't the best students in high school -- and find themselves having to compromise as adults.

2.t: Whatever They Say, We'll Go Our Way
2.o: Ae-ra does a favor for an old classmate at a wedding but things get out of hand. Dong-man visits his parents, who bring up a touchy topic.

3.o: When he sees how happy Ae-ra is after grabbing a new opportunity at work, Dong-man thinks about what it means to follow one's dream.

4.o: Dong-man regrets going to the match but ends up making a drastic decision. Ae-ra takes a tentative step toward trying to pursue what she wants to do.

5.t: It's Okay, Even If You're Jobless
5.o: Ae-ra goes after a thief at the department store but ends up risking her job. Sul-hee is upset that Joo-man isn't being honest about things at work.

6.t: Dear, Don't Give Me That Kiss
6.o: Joo-man stands up for Sul-hee, who goes to a family function by herself. Dong-man tells Park Hye-ran how he truly feels about her.

7.o: Dong-man struggles with his feelings. Ae-ra decides to give Park Mu-bin a chance and sees another side of him. Sul-hee overhears something at work.

8.o: Things between Ae-ra and Dong-man remain awkward. Sul-hee tries to tell people at work about her relationship with Joo-man, but it doesn't go well.

9.t: I'll Make Sure You Never Smirk Again
9.o: After his debut match, Dong-man surprises his family and friends. Ae-ra has another interview and runs into Hye-ran. Joo-man finally reveals the truth.

10.t: I Want to Go With You

11.o: Dong-man and Ae-ra go on an official date. An unwelcome new neighbor moves into the villa. Ae-ra's interest in a new job prospect perplexes Sul-hee.

12.o: When Joo-man doesn't come home, Sul-hee reveals that she has a dream of her own like the rest of them. Dong-man notices something about his father.

13.o: Fearing for his life, Ae-ra tries to stop Dong-man from entering the competition. Sul-hee and Joo-man decide to start fresh -- apart.

14.o: Ae-ra receives two callbacks and faces a choice. Dong-man's big day draws near and he is ready to fight. Kim Tak-su has something else in mind.

15.t: The Clown Always Smiles at Us

16.o: Sul-hee's new business takes off. On the day of the rematch, Dong-man asks Ae-ra a life-changing question.

1.o: After acing an otaku job questionnaire and interview for Amutec, Shinichi Kanou wake up in a strange world with a beautiful maid, Myucel, at his side. He is now in the Holy Eldant Empire and he must, as the general manager, export Japan’s best of anime, manga and video games to this country.

2.o: Shinichi Kanou meet with the empress Petralka Anne Eldante III and misunderstanding ensues. Petralka jealousy for Shinichi relationship with Myucel cause some rukus. Shinichi must explain to Petralka the equality principle.

3.o: It's been a month since Shinichi came to the Holy Eldant Empire and study lesson with Petralka and Myucel are going well. Also the school construction is progressing steadily in Erudanto, and as the construction completion is near, disturbing events will affect the safety of everyone.

4.o: While Myucel is recovering from the terrorist attack, Shinichi is still haunted by the last words of Alessio. “Am I an invader?” he’s wondering while teaching the new students. One day, an alarm is triggered in the mansion perimeter and a furry spy is discovered. Is Erubia Hanaiman really a spy?

5.o: Erbia moves to Shin'ichi's manor, but she starts displaying some strange behavior and he starts believing that she is coming after his life, unaware of her real intentions.

6.o: To deal with the divide between the elf and dwarf students, Shin'ichi organizes a friendly soccer match between both sides and it does not take long for it to become a vicious battle between them.

7.o: Shin'ichi returns briefly to Tokyo to make some shopping just to later find that Myucel had sneaked her way to accompany him and he spends the rest of the day showing her the city.

8.t: The Melancholy of the Supreme Ruler
8.o: Fed up with all the responsibilities piled upon her, Petralka shuts herself in her room and refuses to leave. Shin'ichi, who used to live as a shut-in in Japan, decides then to show her the life he used to have, with all the ups and downs that come from it as well.

9.o: When Minori is awarded with some days of vacation, Shin'ichi decides to take the girls to swim at a nearby lake and they have some fun together until they realize that they are being observed by some uninvited guests.

10.o: When footage from the soccer game leak to the internet in Japan, the government's secret operation in Eldant is at risk of being exposed to the world and Shin'ichi comes with a plan to decieve the public opinion by announcing it as part of a fantasy film production in collaboration with the JSDF, inviting Petralka to play the main role.

11.o: Shin'ichi's efforts to spread the Otaku culture bear fruit. However, when there is a shortage of products from Japan, leading to various conflicts amongst the people in Eldant, Shin'ichi learns the true intentions of the Japanese government and falls into despair upon it, until Myusel inspires him to come with a solution.

12.o: In response to Shin'ichi's act of defiance, the Japanese Government orders the JSDF to kill him. After two failed attempts, Shin'ichi comes with a plan to convince the politicians in Tokyo to spare him and keep supporting his efforts to spread the Otaku culture in Eldant instead.

1.o: Amato Takeru, a high school student, has just moved to Akihabara. He's chosen a house with cheap rent, but with one particular imperfection: a hole in the living room floor. When he peeks into it, a girl pops out... And so begins the hectic life of Takeru and the cat Eto-musume, Nya-tan.

2.t: A Strange and Loving Ox Relationship
2.o: Takeru awakes in the morning to the smell of meat cooking, and finds Nya-tan preparing breakfast over a blazing fire. More and more Eto-shin girls have appeared from the hole in the living room, posing a threat to the peace and quiet of Takeru's life in his new home.

3.o: Nya-tan and Uri-tan have made new homes for themselves on Takeru's property (without asking him), and the three of them go shopping for new furniture. Nya-tan has no money, so she tries to get an advance on her paycheck at her part-time job...

4.t: Eyes of a Rabbit, Ears of a Rabbit
4.o: Having been saved by Uri-tan, Nya-tan returns to the maid café Eto, where Usa-tan criticizes her character. A meeting of the Eto-shin whose characters don't stand out enough begins!

5.o: Takeru is stuck in bed sick, and the sheep Eto-shin, Mei-tan, determines that what he has is no ordinary cold. With all the Eto-shin going wild as Takeru's Sol/Lull rages out of control, Nya-tan and Mei-tan decide to battle the unknown virus.

6.t: The Three Laughers of the Tiger's Scheme
6.o: Nya-tan tries to find some way to get Sol/Lull Seals without effort. Her master Shima-tan catches her trying to bribe Inu-tan and Key-tan with their favorite treats. Can Nya-tan win the battle with her enraged master?!

7.o: Nya-tan messes with Shar-tan's hair ornament and ends up petrified. Shar-tan says she'll need the antidote in order to return to normal and takes Takeru on a journey to find it, but they end up in a place filled with Nya-tan's memories...

8.t: An Equestrian Fit for a Cat
8.o: It's time once again for the annual Takamagahara Commemorative Maid Café Eto Manager's Cup! Uma-tan is determined to breathe new life into this event of the Eto realm that has steadily lost popularity, but Nyaa-tan's intrusion throws the race into chaos!

9.t: The Beauty of Flowers, Bird Steps, and Moon
9.o: Piyo-tan is angry when Nyaa-tan ridicules her beloved hobby, shogi. Nyaa-tan gets cocky and challenges her to a Sol/Lull Seal battle, and Piyo-tan chooses the battle method... but Nyaa-tan has no idea what the rules are, so she begs Takeru to train her!

10.o: Mo-tan is still chasing Nyaa-tan around everywhere. Apparently, her love stems from a memory the two of them shared long ago. Meanwhile, Chu-tan is on the move in her mission to destroy Nyaa-tan... so Mo-tan rises to defend Nyaa-tan.

11.o: Reincarnation is impossible?! When Nya-tan has trouble accepting what happened to Mo-tan in her battle with Chu-tan, Mo-tan entrusts the last of her strength to her beloved Nya-tan. Meanwhile, the Eto-shin do everything they can to save Chu-tan from being engulfed by the negative Sol/Lull gathering within her.

12.o: After receiving the last Sol/Lull Seal she needed, Nya-tan challenges Chu-tan to battle. What was the technique Nya-tan came up with to help Chu-tan long ago? After two thousand years of passing each other by, the two of their hearts will come face-to-face once more!

1.o: A baffling suicide, an anguished father searching for his missing daughter and the robbery of medieval treasures strain the talents of DC Endeavour Morse.

2.o: A murder investigation sends Endeavour and DI Thursday to a girls' school which is haunted by memories of an atrocity committed a hundred years earlier.

3.o: As a multiple murderer haunts the city strangling married women with a silk stocking, Endeavour and DI Thursday's emotional lives are turned upside down.

4.o: As 1966 draws to a close, the body of a disreputable journalist found in mysterious circumstances threatens to expose past horrors. As the investigation deepens, Endeavour and Thursday face corruption in Oxford's corridors of power.

1.o: A vanishing bus conductress and a raucous funfair draw DC Endeavour Morse back to duty.

2.o: The shock death of an artist in a house fire leaves Oxford city police baffled.

3.o: A seemingly routine missing persons case takes on a troubling dimension.

4.o: Morse is recruited by an old college mentor to look into the safety of his estranged wife.

1.o: As Endeavour and Thursday deal with the heartbreak of Joan's departure, a death at East Cowley Slipper Baths hurls Oxford's Finest into their darkest adventure.

1.o: The newly promoted Detective Sergeant Morse investigates when a famous international thief tries to steal a Faberge egg from an auction. The case leads to the gruesome murders of an academic and a gangster, and Morse is convinced the deaths are the work of the same man. As he struggles with his new responsibilities, he finds himself forced to mentor a younger partner.

3.o: The railway takes centre stage as Endeavour investigates the disappearance of a local woman - with initial fears linking it to the unsolved murder of a teenager, killed several years earlier.

5.o: An assassination attempt at an international sporting event opens a new case for Endeavour and Thursday, but their investigation is quickly brought to an unexpected end.

6.o: After the mysterious disappearance of a teacher, Endeavour finds himself investigating the dark and secret world of a public school.

1.o: With the Cowley team scattered across Oxfordshire, Endeavour finds himself policing a lonely country patch, and back in uniform. His day job is a monotonous investigation of missing livestock and stolen tractors. But when he discovers the dead body of a missing schoolgirl, it opens this quiet backwater to the roar of Castle Gate CID – now staffed by Thursday and an old adversary, the newly promoted DCI Ronnie Box, alongside sidekick DS Alan Jago.

2.o: As the highly-anticipated moon landings of Apollo 11 draw near, Endeavour finds himself investigating the death of a promising young astrophysicist and his girlfriend. Their deaths seeming to be a result of a tragic car accident on first inspection, with the clues pointing to foul play, Endeavour enlists the help of an injured Thursday to uncover the truth.

3.o: The murder of a chocolate factory owner during a local hunt leads Endeavour to the sleepy village of Chigton Green. When he learns of a vicious campaign of gossip and rumour, it seems likely that two murders are connected. One of the targets, a beautiful, single mother, captures Endeavour's attention, giving him food for thought about the future.

4.o: When a librarian is gruesomely murdered at the Bodleian, Endeavour and Thursday have little to go on besides a set of muddy boot prints. With the two main suspects having their own motives for killing the librarian, Endeavour digs deeper into their backgrounds, tracking a trail that appears to connect to seemingly innocent college bequest.

1.o: Whilst Endeavour sees in 1970 at a Venetian opera, a grisly murder on an Oxford towpath speaks to Thursday's intuition. Back in Oxford, Endeavour meets a kindred spirit.

3.o: Endeavour uncovers a potential link between a series of peculiar accidents leading him to an all-women Oxford college determined to eschew co-education.

1.o: Opening the series in 1971, a death threat to Oxford Wanderers’ star striker Jack Swift places Endeavour and his team at the heart of the glitz and glamour of 1970s football, exposing the true cost of success and celebrity, and with it, a deep-rooted division that is soon reflected much closer to home.

3.o: A series of death notices in the Oxford Mail, each with a cryptic message, provides clues to Endeavour’s final investigation, while Thursday’s past catches up with him.

North Korea send their elite Special Forces instructor, Kim Hang Ah.The South Korean Prince Lee Jae Ha who is scheduled to be discharged from military service is hesitant to leave the court to be an ordinary citizen, after receiving the request by the royal commission's decision for him to participate in the General Assembly. There, the North-South confrontation officers have been gathered, Hang Ah is runnin

2.o: Jae Ha who is insulted by Hang Ah finally joins the training after being threatened. He and Hang Ah are assigned to the same dormitory. At the same time, there are rumours flying around that Kim Bong Goo personally kills his father and inherits his father's military Empire, Club M.

3.o: The scar at the bottom of Hang Ah's heart is made in to a public joke by Jae Ha. However, Hang Ah's tears causes Jae Ha to feel guilty and dejected too. They decide to determine the winner on a treadmill in a war of words. But Club M places a bomb on the treadmill, which endangeres their lives...

4.t: Another Crisis for the North-South Unified Team

5.o: Jae Ha decides to openly declare his love for Hang Ah. Hang Ah knows that Jae Ha is lying. To teach Jae Ha a lesson, she decides to go to South Korea to participate in a matchmaking date. On the other hand, Jae Ha who schemes to make Hang Ah fall in love with him and then dump her, carefully arranges the venue.

6.t: The Pretense That Turned Into Reality
6.o: Hang Ah rejects Jae Ha's confession but she still cares about Jae Ha's whereabouts. Jae Ha confesses to Hang Ah that it is all a pretense. Hang Ah is heartbroken. 8.t: Jae Ha Ascended The Throne, Jae Shin Suffered from Amnesia

The Secretary-General informes the King about Eun Gyu Tae's strange death, and that he receives Bong Goo's text message and understand that their own mistakes had led to the death of the King and Queen. Jae Shin regainedconsciousness in the hospital, but has lost her memory. It is also then that they learned that she has become paralyzed.

9.t: Hang Ah Heard of a Liable Seige

Jae Ha who sees it all on TV is filled with anger and immediately orders the King's death to be clarified that it is not related to North Korea... "

10.t: ang Ah Returned to the North With Her Father

In the palace, Jae Shin is told by Hang Ah that she will be coming back, but Hang Ah's departure makes Jae Ha regret his actions. When Hang Ah's father comes to pick her up to return to North Korea, they decides to start life anew, but she suffers from a miscarriage...

11.t: Jae Ha Forces His Way Into North Korea

On the other hand, the North Korea commander requests to Hang Ah toexpose Jae Ha, but is cleverly rejected by Hang Ah.

12.t: Rescuing the King of South Korea

13.t: Jae Ha Decides To Continue in the WOC

Should the game fails to cancel the North-South alliance, against all the odds, Jae Ha makes arrangements for Princess Jae Shin to conduct provisional duties on behalf of the King. Hang Ah has also taken to her responsibility to protect the princess. She goes to the hospital and tries to convince the princess to accept her.

15.t: Jae Shin Confesses Her Love to Shi Kyung

18.o: Hang Ah flies to a farmhouse and is reported by the man of the house. Bong Goo retaliates and Hang Ah is defined as a defector and is detained. 19.t: Bong Goo Kidnaps Jae Ha Again

But Hang Ah decides to return to the North to try to stop the war. And the two love-birds burst into tears of sadness...

1.t: Because I Can Go to Akiba for Free

2.o: Imaizumi challenges Sakamichi to a race up the school's steep rear gate slope. To spice up the competition, Imaizumi agrees to join the anime club if he loses. Sakamichi gives it his all, hoping to reform the club.

3.o: The race between Sakamichi and Imaizumi continues. Imaizumi has passed Sakamichi, but thanks to a seat adjustment from Miki, Sakamichi has more power than ever before.

4.o: With the rear gate slope race over, Sakamichi returns to Akiba to buy some more anime goods. There, he runs into Naruko Shoukichi, a boy with a Kansai accent who's riding a bike.

5.t: The Sohoku High School Bicycle Racing Team

6.o: The welcoming race begins. Sakamichi is excited to, once again, race against Imaizumi and Naruko.

7.o: With his new road racer, Sakamichi quickly moves up from sixth to fourth place and makes up a five minute deficit. The captain sees Sakamichi's determination and decides to test his skills.

8.o: Sakamichi finally catches up to Imaizumi and Naruko, stoking their competitive natures.

9.o: Determined to become the King of the Mountain in Minegayama, Sakamichi raises his RPMs to catch up to Imaizumi.

10.o: With the welcoming race over, each of the first years is given special training by other members of the team.

11.o: One day has passed since special training. The freshmen are in class when they learn that the Inter-High Preliminaries have started.

12.o: The Sohoku High bicycle racing club holds a training camp to prepare for the Inter-High. As a carsick Sakamichi makes his way to camp, he encounters cyclist Manami Sangaku.

13.o: The first day of training is over. Imaizumi, Naruko, and Sugimoto have all managed to complete 200km while Onoda has only completed 165km.

14.o: The third day of camp. While riding alone in the early morning, Sakamichi runs into Manami, the boy he met on the first day of camp.

15.o: After his meeting with Manami, Sakamichi is more excited than ever to take part in the Inter-High. In order to participate, Sakamichi realizes he must first ride 1,000 kilometers and begins matching paces and laps with Imaizumi and Naruko.

16.o: Second years Teshima and Aoyagi stand between the first years and their goal to finish 1,000 kilometers. In order to protect their lead, the second years challenge the first years.

17.o: After Sakamichi breaks through Teshima's impregnable guard, Teshima loses his will to fight. Aoyagi's insistence that they go to the Inter-High together, however, gives Teshima the strength to carry on.

18.o: After falling to last place, Sakamichi catches up to Imaizumi, Naruko, Teshima, and Aoyagi. Admist their emotions, the five boys clash in an all out sprint to the finish line!

19.o: Having completed the difficult training camp, Sakamichi has grown, but lacks the experience and strength of the other members. Disillusioned, he begins to give up on his dream of going to the Inter-High.

20.o: As Sohoku's team eagerly awaits the upcoming Inter-High, the Hakone club holds individual elimination races and fills all but one remaining spot.

21.o: The first years learn about the previous year's Inter-High and the rivalry between Kinjou and Fukutomi.

18.t: Please Stay Alive, I'm Grateful You're Alive, Honey
18.o: يعترف "دو كيونغ" بكل شيء لـ"هاي يونغ" ويذهبان لرؤية طبيبه، بينما تخبر "هاي يونغ" والديها أنها تريد أن تعيش معه.

1.t: Until I Found Out the Secret.
1.o: A sudden accident shatters the everyday happiness two couples had always taken for granted — and exposes a secret one of them kept hidden for years.

2.t: The Smell of the Third Friday
2.o: Itsuki reveals he saw Azusa and Mitsuru together on "the third Friday." Sakiko wants to believe her husband, but begins investigating their secret.

3.o: As their investigation stalls, Sakiko and Itsuki bond over shared frustration. A call from the police leads them to retrace Mitsuru and Azusa's steps.

4.o: The discovery of two sets of tickets forces Sakiko and Itsuki to confront the possibility of an affair. Sakiko then finds a new clue on Mitsuru's phone.

5.o: Sakiko follows Mitsuru's trail all the way to Nagano, while an unexpected guest from Azusa's childhood pays Itsuki a visit.

6.o: A sudden return brings Sakiko, Itsuki and a familiar face together for the first time. As truths emerge, Sakiko reflects on her life with Mitsuru.

7.o: A familiar face challenges Sakiko and Itsuki to define their relationship, as the truth about Mitsuru and Azusa's third Friday meetings unravels.

8.o: Sakiko doesn't return after learning the truth. Worried, Mitsuru gathers her friends at a café, hoping to learn more about the side of her he never knew.

9.o: Sakiko enjoys time with a man and his children by the sea, while a troubled Mitsuru learns his wife was a very different person before they met.

10.o: Mitsuru treads carefully, but Sakiko's fears of losing him again take over. She opens up to Itsuki as all three choose the paths their lives will take.

1.o: بعد أن غرق في الديون وتقطعت به السبل، يوافق "هيوك جون بيون" على العمل في وظيفة مشبوهة في متجر بقالة بأجر يعادل خمسين ضعف الحد الأدنى... وسرعان ما يدرك السبب وراء ذلك.

2.o: تُعرَض على "هيوك جون"، الخائف والمرتبك بعد وظيفته الأخيرة، فرصة جديدة مقرونة بشرط غريب، وهو ألّا يحيد بصره عن المهرج.

3.o: يعاهد "هيوك جون" نفسه على تجنب الوظائف الخطرة، إلى أن تلوح له مهمة لتوزيع الحليب مقابل أجر يعادل مئتي ضعف الحد الأدنى. وهذه المرّة، هو مستعد تمامًا لكل ما قد يعترض طريقه.

4.o: بعد أن تكتشف "جي يون"، شقيقة "هيوك جون"، أمر عمله الجديد ووكالة التوظيف، يقودها الفضول إلى مناوبة ليلية تتحوّل فيها أسوأ مخاوفها إلى واقع.

5.o: منتحلًا صفة متقدم آخر، ينضم "هيوك جون" إلى تجربة سريرية، لكن لقاء غير متوقع بأحد أصدقائه يحوّل وظيفته إلى عملية إنقاذ.

6.o: مع تزايد الأسئلة وغياب الإجابات، يقبل "هيوك جون" بالعمل في مناوبة ليلية داخل موقع بناء، ويكتشف الرعب الحقيقي وراء الوكالة الغامضة.

7.o: رغم تحذيره من أن مهمته الأخيرة ليست كسابقاتها، ينضم "هيوك جون" إلى استعراض بطابع الحكايات الخرافية في مدينة ترفيهية، حيث تنتظره الإجابات التي يبحث عنها.

8.o: يجمع مهرجان مروّع شمل الجميع، فيما يواجه "هيوك جون" قرارًا يغيّر مجرى الحياة، فهل سيتمكّن أخيرًا من ترك وظيفة الكوابيس إلى الأبد؟
